replacement_rules.evidence: Generate and validate target evidence honestly. Never synthesize historical successful outcomes or infer current identities from a restored repository.
replacement_rules.integer_tokens: Generate integer JSON values and decimal Python integer literals in place of int(token) expressions.
replacement_rules.manifests: After all substitutions, regenerate target runtime manifests and dependent source/configuration pins. Public template hashes do not qualify target execution.
replacement_rules.sha256_tokens: Generate 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits from exact target artifact bytes.
replacement_rules.string_tokens: Use canonical target strings and correctly quote Python and JSON string literals.
replacement_rules.unknown_tokens: Refuse unresolved or undeclared tokens before execution.
